name: indexed-lookup-vs-nested-scan
explain: Contrast quadratic O(N*M) nested loop scans with linear O(N+M) multi-map index lookups, properly handling duplicate keys and index construction costs.
steps: Construct candidate database with duplicate identity keys. || Compare comparison counts between nested scan and hash index. || Assert exact result parity and duplicate key resolution.
expect: All indexed lookup vs nested scan assertions verified successfully.

name: async-event-loop-cpu-starvation
explain: Demonstrate that awaiting CPU-bound work does not yield execution in asyncio, starving health checks and timers unless offloaded to worker threads or processes.
steps: Simulate long CPU hashing loop inside an async coroutine. || Observe that health check probes are blocked on the single-threaded event loop. || Assert that offloading via asyncio.to_thread restores concurrent responsiveness.
expect: All async event loop CPU starvation assertions verified successfully.

name: cancellation-resource-cleanup-guard
explain: Guard stateful resources against asyncio.CancelledError using try/finally blocks to prevent permanent queue.join() deadlocks and unreleased mutexes.
steps: Simulate task cancellation during in-flight queue processing. || Show that unshielded worker fails to call task_done, deadlocking queue.join(). || Assert that resilient finally cleanup unblocks the queue cleanly.
expect: All cancellation resource cleanup assertions verified successfully.

name: process-thread-failure-isolation
explain: Compare thread shared memory race conditions during check-then-set operations with process address-space failure isolation.
steps: Trigger check-then-set race condition across concurrent threads. || Protect thread access using mutual exclusion locks. || Assert that child process crashes are isolated without killing peer processes.
expect: All process and thread failure isolation assertions verified successfully.

name: file-ingestion-memory-amplification
explain: Demonstrate heap memory amplification from multi-stage retention (compressed bytes, raw text, dict AST, domain objects) and mitigate with streaming iterators.
steps: Generate gzipped JSON lines file. || Measure memory amplification from retaining all intermediate parsing representations. || Assert that streaming generator processes lines in constant working memory.
expect: All file ingestion memory amplification assertions verified successfully.

name: deadline-budget-propagation
explain: Propagate end-to-end deadline budgets across multi-step distributed operations to prevent cascading compute waste on client-abandoned requests.
steps: Simulate 4-step pipeline where independent timeouts exceed client gateway budget. || Implement deadline budget calculation before each downstream invocation. || Assert that pipeline halts early before executing expensive compute steps.
expect: All deadline budget propagation assertions verified successfully.
